newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline steady at lower levels, trade nervous.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline steady at lower levels, trade nervous.

text.p: NWE gasoline stabilized at levels about $4 below Thursday as crude oil halted yesterday's sharp selloff, traders said on Friday.
But this week's volatility frayed traders' nerves and further direction was looked for from the NYMEX.
A Eurograde barge traded at $221 fob ARA, down $4, and unleaded regular was holding at a $6 discount, though traders said this market was very thin.
"The fact is the market doesn't know what to do. It's very nervous," said one trader.
Gasoline's fundamentals were believed to be supportive.
